author: A5 (pool)
schemaSource: src/lib/tutor/vietlishCorpus.ts -> VietlishCorpusEntry { vietlish, natural, sourcePattern, category, frequency, context }
definition: Each entry is a NEW Vietnamese L1-interference candidate matching the live VIETLISH_CORPUS entry schema EXACTLY. These are staged for human review BEFORE any promotion into src/lib/tutor/vietlishCorpus.ts. This file is imported by no engine module — review queue only. Every `vietlish` string is verified disjoint from live VIETLISH_CORPUS and all pending waves 1-11 by the guard test.
disjointFrom: live VIETLISH_CORPUS (src/lib/tutor/vietlishCorpus.ts); all pending waves 1-11 in tests/regression/golden-set/_pending-guards/

entries.vietlish: she not eat pork
entries.natural: she doesn't eat pork
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy không ăn thịt heo -> bare negation no do-support
entries.context: She not eat pork because of her religion, please check the menu.

entries.vietlish: I also not understand what you mean
entries.natural: I don't understand what you mean either
entries.sourcePattern: tôi cũng không hiểu -> also negated without either or auxiliary
entries.context: He explained twice but I also not understand what you mean.

entries.vietlish: we plan go to beach this Sunday
entries.natural: we're planning to go to the beach this Sunday
entries.sourcePattern: dự định đi biển -> plan + bare infinitive without to
entries.context: We plan go to beach this Sunday if the weather is nice.

entries.vietlish: I try open the door but it locked
entries.natural: I tried to open the door but it was locked
entries.sourcePattern: thử mở cửa nhưng bị khóa -> bare infinitive after try
entries.context: I try open the door but it locked from inside, nobody answers.

entries.vietlish: she want to cut her hair short
entries.natural: she wants to cut her hair short
entries.sourcePattern: muốn cắt tóc ngắn -> third-person singular -s dropped
entries.context: She want to cut her hair short before the summer heat starts.

entries.vietlish: he is the person that I most respect
entries.natural: he is the person I respect the most
entries.sourcePattern: người tôi kính trọng nhất -> superlative fronted before verb in relative clause
entries.context: He is the person that I most respect in the whole family, I look up to him.

entries.vietlish: we go by his car yesterday
entries.natural: we went in his car yesterday
entries.sourcePattern: đi bằng xe của anh ấy -> by used for transport instead of in
entries.context: We go by his car yesterday to the party outside the city.

entries.vietlish: I wait here for you already ten minute
entries.natural: I've been waiting here for you for ten minutes
entries.sourcePattern: chờ được mười phút rồi -> already for perfective, no present perfect
entries.context: I wait here for you already ten minute, please hurry up.

entries.vietlish: no need to worry, I handle it
entries.natural: no need to worry, I'll handle it
entries.sourcePattern: không cần lo, tôi lo -> bare present for future
entries.context: No need to worry, I handle it, you just focus on the meeting.

entries.vietlish: she left because she missing her family
entries.natural: she left because she missed her family
entries.sourcePattern: vì nhớ nhà -> progressive without auxiliary in past subordinate clause
entries.context: She left because she missing her family in the countryside and could not bear it.

entries.vietlish: they have a good relationship to each other
entries.natural: they have a good relationship with each other
entries.sourcePattern: có mối quan hệ tốt với nhau -> to instead of with for relationship
entries.context: They have a good relationship to each other after years of working together.

entries.vietlish: I cannot believe my eye
entries.natural: I can't believe my eyes
entries.sourcePattern: không tin được mắt mình -> eye without plural
entries.context: When I saw the final score, I cannot believe my eye.

entries.vietlish: he come back already last night
entries.natural: he came back last night
entries.sourcePattern: anh ấy về rồi hôm qua -> already for perfective with past time
entries.context: He come back already last night, why did you not call him?

entries.vietlish: this coat keep you warm in the mountains
entries.natural: this coat will keep you warm in the mountains
entries.sourcePattern: cái áo này giữ ấm -> present simple for future
entries.context: This coat keep you warm in the mountains, it is very thick.

entries.vietlish: I not yet receive the package
entries.natural: I haven't received the package yet
entries.sourcePattern: chưa nhận -> not yet + base verb, no auxiliary or have
entries.context: I not yet receive the package, they said it was delivered yesterday.

entries.vietlish: my friend no money to travel this year
entries.natural: my friend doesn't have money to travel this year
entries.sourcePattern: bạn tôi không có tiền -> no for does not have
entries.context: My friend no money to travel this year, she saves every month.

entries.vietlish: she has beautiful and tall
entries.natural: she is beautiful and tall
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy có vóc dáng đẹp và cao -> have for be with adjective predicate
entries.context: She has beautiful and tall so many people notice her wherever she goes.

entries.vietlish: she learn English from small
entries.natural: she has been learning English since she was little
entries.sourcePattern: học tiếng Anh từ nhỏ -> from small calque of từ nhỏ
entries.context: She learn English from small so her pronunciation is very good.

entries.vietlish: the dog bark all night make me not sleep
entries.natural: the dog barked all night and kept me awake
entries.sourcePattern: chó sủa cả đêm làm tôi không ngủ được -> causal make-clause
entries.context: The dog bark all night make me not sleep, I am exhausted now.

entries.vietlish: I want to become a teacher in the future later
entries.natural: I want to become a teacher in the future
entries.sourcePattern: trong tương lai sau này -> future and later stacked
entries.context: I want to become a teacher in the future later, after my degree.

entries.vietlish: we play football since morning
entries.natural: we have been playing football since morning
entries.sourcePattern: chơi từ sáng -> present simple for present perfect progressive
entries.context: We play football since morning, everyone is tired and hungry now.

entries.vietlish: I only can help you tomorrow
entries.natural: I can only help you tomorrow
entries.sourcePattern: chỉ ngày mai có thể -> only inserted between subject and modal
entries.context: I only can help you tomorrow, today I have appointments all day.

entries.vietlish: she too tired can not move
entries.natural: she is so tired she can't move
entries.sourcePattern: mệt quá không đi nổi -> too + adjective without so...that structure
entries.context: She too tired can not move after the long hike in the heat.

entries.vietlish: the information is not correct already
entries.natural: the information is no longer correct
entries.sourcePattern: thông tin không còn chính xác nữa rồi -> already for no-longer completive
entries.context: Please check again, the information is not correct already.

entries.vietlish: I have to take a test about this chapter
entries.natural: I have a test on this chapter
entries.sourcePattern: thi về chương này -> about for on in test context
entries.context: Tomorrow I have to take a test about this chapter, I am not ready.

entries.vietlish: my father work at home today
entries.natural: my father is working from home today
entries.sourcePattern: bố làm việc ở nhà hôm nay -> present simple for current progressive
entries.context: My father work at home today so the house is noisier than usual.

entries.vietlish: I borrow you my notes from class
entries.natural: I'll lend you my notes from class
entries.sourcePattern: cho mượn -> borrow used backward (subject lends not borrows)
entries.context: I borrow you my notes from class, just give them back tomorrow.

entries.vietlish: she was very active in the past but now lazy
entries.natural: she used to be very active but she's lazy now
entries.sourcePattern: trước đây năng động nhưng giờ lười -> used to not expressed for past habit
entries.context: She was very active in the past but now lazy since she started working remotely.

entries.vietlish: I miss you very much, long time not see
entries.natural: I miss you a lot, it's been a long time since I've seen you
entries.sourcePattern: nhớ nhiều, lâu không gặp -> stacked clauses with tenses dropped
entries.context: I miss you very much, long time not see, I hope you are doing well.

entries.vietlish: she all day study at the library
entries.natural: she studies at the library all day
entries.sourcePattern: suốt ngày học ở thư viện -> time expression fronted between subject and verb
entries.context: She all day study at the library to prepare for the final exam.

entries.vietlish: I feel so free and comfortable at the beach
entries.natural: I feel so relaxed and comfortable at the beach
entries.sourcePattern: cảm thấy thoải mái -> free as stative adjective transferred from thoải mái
entries.context: I feel so free and comfortable at the beach, I do not want to go home.

entries.vietlish: he three times ask me the same question
entries.natural: he asked me the same question three times
entries.sourcePattern: hỏi tôi ba lần -> frequency expression before verb
entries.context: He three times ask me the same question in one meeting, it was exhausting.

entries.vietlish: can you help me to tell him I will be late
entries.natural: can you tell him for me that I'll be late
entries.sourcePattern: giúp tôi nói với anh ấy -> help me + infinitive to relay message
entries.context: Can you help me to tell him I will be late, my phone battery is dead.

entries.vietlish: I two months ago started this job
entries.natural: I started this job two months ago
entries.sourcePattern: tôi bắt đầu công việc này hai tháng trước -> time expression between subject and verb
entries.context: I two months ago started this job and I am still getting used to it.

entries.vietlish: she is close friend with my sister
entries.natural: she is close friends with my sister
entries.sourcePattern: thân thiết -> close friend singular for close friends plural idiom
entries.context: She is close friend with my sister so she visits our house often.

entries.vietlish: I very want to go on vacation this month
entries.natural: I really want to go on vacation this month
entries.sourcePattern: tôi rất muốn -> very fronted before main verb instead of modifying adjective
entries.context: I very want to go on vacation this month but work keeps me busy.

entries.vietlish: she not answer my call this morning
entries.natural: she didn't answer my call this morning
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy không nghe máy -> bare negation without auxiliary in past
entries.context: She not answer my call this morning, I hope she is okay.

entries.vietlish: we finish eat, let's go
entries.natural: we've finished eating, let's go
entries.sourcePattern: ăn xong rồi -> bare verb after finish, no gerund
entries.context: We finish eat, let's go before it gets too late outside.

entries.vietlish: he spend too much time on his phone
entries.natural: he spends too much time on his phone
entries.sourcePattern: anh ấy dành quá nhiều thời gian -> third-person -s dropped
entries.context: He spend too much time on his phone instead of studying for the exam.

entries.vietlish: I still remember the day we first meet
entries.natural: I still remember the day we first met
entries.sourcePattern: ngày đầu tiên gặp nhau -> relative clause verb not shifted to past
entries.context: I still remember the day we first meet, it was raining heavily outside.

entries.vietlish: I also am hungry after the meeting
entries.natural: I'm hungry too after the meeting
entries.sourcePattern: tôi cũng đói -> also placed before am adjacent to subject
entries.context: Don't start without me, I also am hungry after the meeting.

entries.vietlish: she still is waiting for the result
entries.natural: she is still waiting for the result
entries.sourcePattern: vẫn còn chờ -> still placed before auxiliary instead of after
entries.context: Don't call her, she still is waiting for the result from the doctor.

entries.vietlish: I often am tired after a long shift
entries.natural: I'm often tired after a long shift
entries.sourcePattern: thường mệt -> frequency adverb fronted before am
entries.context: I often am tired after a long shift, especially during the rainy season.

entries.vietlish: we never are sure about the weather here
entries.natural: we are never sure about the weather here
entries.sourcePattern: không bao giờ chắc -> never placed before auxiliary
entries.context: We never are sure about the weather here in the highlands.

entries.vietlish: a red small bag is on the table
entries.natural: a small red bag is on the table
entries.sourcePattern: cái túi màu đỏ nhỏ -> color before size in Vietnamese adjective order
entries.context: A red small bag is on the table, can you check if it belongs to anyone?

entries.vietlish: we visited an old beautiful temple near town
entries.natural: we visited a beautiful old temple near town
entries.sourcePattern: ngôi đền cổ đẹp -> age before beauty in Vietnamese adjective order
entries.context: We visited an old beautiful temple near town during the festival.

entries.vietlish: they built a new big house outside the city
entries.natural: they built a big new house outside the city
entries.sourcePattern: ngôi nhà mới to -> new before big in Vietnamese description order
entries.context: They built a new big house outside the city and moved in last month.

entries.vietlish: where you buy this jacket so nice
entries.natural: where did you buy this jacket? it's so nice
entries.sourcePattern: bạn mua áo khoác này ở đâu -> no do-support in wh-question
entries.context: Where you buy this jacket so nice? I want to get one too.

entries.vietlish: why you are so quiet today
entries.natural: why are you so quiet today
entries.sourcePattern: tại sao hôm nay bạn im lặng vậy -> no subject-auxiliary inversion
entries.context: Why you are so quiet today? Did something happen at school?

entries.vietlish: what time they usually eat dinner
entries.natural: what time do they usually eat dinner
entries.sourcePattern: mấy giờ họ thường ăn tối -> no do-support in wh-question
entries.context: What time they usually eat dinner in your family?

entries.vietlish: the book which I bought it last week was good
entries.natural: the book I bought last week was good
entries.sourcePattern: quyển sách mà tôi mua nó -> resumptive pronoun in relative clause
entries.context: The book which I bought it last week was good, I already finished it.

entries.vietlish: she is the girl that I told you about her
entries.natural: she is the girl I told you about
entries.sourcePattern: cô gái mà tôi nói với bạn về cô ấy -> resumptive pronoun in relative clause
entries.context: She is the girl that I told you about her, she is in our class.

entries.vietlish: the company that I work for it is in Hanoi
entries.natural: the company I work for is in Hanoi
entries.sourcePattern: công ty mà tôi làm cho -> resumptive pronoun it left after preposition
entries.context: The company that I work for it is in Hanoi, near the lake.

entries.vietlish: he drives very careful on the highway
entries.natural: he drives very carefully on the highway
entries.sourcePattern: lái xe rất cẩn thận -> adjective form used instead of adverb
entries.context: Don't worry, he drives very careful on the highway and never speeds.

entries.vietlish: she speaks very polite to everyone at work
entries.natural: she speaks very politely to everyone at work
entries.sourcePattern: nói rất lịch sự -> adjective instead of adverb after verb of manner
entries.context: She speaks very polite to everyone at work, even difficult customers.

entries.vietlish: he answered the question very intelligent
entries.natural: he answered the question very intelligently
entries.sourcePattern: trả lời rất thông minh -> adjective instead of adverb after verb
entries.context: He answered the question very intelligent and the class was impressed.

entries.vietlish: she sings very beautiful on stage
entries.natural: she sings beautifully on stage
entries.sourcePattern: hát rất đẹp -> adjective instead of adverb for manner
entries.context: She sings very beautiful on stage, everyone applauded at the end.

entries.vietlish: even me cannot solve this problem
entries.natural: even I can't solve this problem
entries.sourcePattern: ngay cả tôi cũng không -> even me with object pronoun after even
entries.context: The math question was so hard, even me cannot solve this problem.

entries.vietlish: my father he works in a hospital in Hanoi
entries.natural: my father works in a hospital in Hanoi
entries.sourcePattern: bố tôi, ông ấy làm việc -> topic-comment with resumptive he
entries.context: My father he works in a hospital in Hanoi for over twenty years.

entries.vietlish: this weather, it is very bad for outdoor events
entries.natural: the weather is very bad for outdoor events
entries.sourcePattern: thời tiết hôm nay, nó rất tệ -> topic-comment with resumptive it
entries.context: This weather, it is very bad for outdoor events, we should move inside.

entries.vietlish: my phone, I left it at home this morning
entries.natural: I left my phone at home this morning
entries.sourcePattern: điện thoại của tôi, tôi để ở nhà -> topic fronting of object with resumptive
entries.context: My phone, I left it at home this morning so I cannot call you now.

entries.vietlish: this problem, nobody can solve it in one day
entries.natural: nobody can solve this problem in one day
entries.sourcePattern: vấn đề này, không ai có thể giải quyết nó -> topic-comment construction
entries.context: This problem, nobody can solve it in one day, it needs a team effort.

entries.vietlish: never I have seen such a big crowd before
entries.natural: I have never seen such a big crowd before
entries.sourcePattern: chưa bao giờ -> never fronted to sentence start without inversion
entries.context: Never I have seen such a big crowd before in this small town.

entries.vietlish: already he has finished all the assignments
entries.natural: he has already finished all the assignments
entries.sourcePattern: đã hoàn thành rồi -> already fronted to sentence start
entries.context: Already he has finished all the assignments before lunch today.

entries.vietlish: still she loves him after everything he did
entries.natural: she still loves him after everything he did
entries.sourcePattern: vẫn còn yêu -> still fronted to sentence start
entries.context: Still she loves him after everything he did, it is hard to understand.

entries.vietlish: I tomorrow will be free all day
entries.natural: I'll be free all day tomorrow
entries.sourcePattern: ngày mai tôi sẽ rảnh -> time expression inserted between subject and auxiliary
entries.context: I tomorrow will be free all day, let's make a plan to meet.

entries.vietlish: a sharp long knife is best for slicing
entries.natural: a long sharp knife is best for slicing
entries.sourcePattern: con dao dài bén -> sharpness before length in Vietnamese adjective order
entries.context: A sharp long knife is best for slicing meat, the cook told me.

entries.vietlish: she always is the first to arrive
entries.natural: she is always the first to arrive
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy luôn luôn -> always placed before the auxiliary
entries.context: She always is the first to arrive and last to leave the office.

entries.vietlish: how long you have been living here
entries.natural: how long have you been living here
entries.sourcePattern: bao lâu bạn sống ở đây rồi -> no auxiliary inversion in wh-question
entries.context: How long you have been living here? It looks like you know everyone.

entries.vietlish: the new teacher, she is very patient with students
entries.natural: the new teacher is very patient with students
entries.sourcePattern: cô giáo mới, cô ấy rất kiên nhẫn -> topic-comment with resumptive she
entries.context: The new teacher, she is very patient with students who struggle.

entries.vietlish: I quick finish my food to catch the bus
entries.natural: I quickly finished my food to catch the bus
entries.sourcePattern: ăn nhanh -> quick as adverb before verb without -ly
entries.context: I quick finish my food to catch the bus on time.

entries.vietlish: how often you visit your grandparents
entries.natural: how often do you visit your grandparents
entries.sourcePattern: bao lâu bạn thăm ông bà -> no do-support in how-often question
entries.context: How often you visit your grandparents? Every weekend or less?

entries.vietlish: who you think is the best candidate
entries.natural: who do you think is the best candidate
entries.sourcePattern: bạn nghĩ ai là -> no do-support in wh-question with embedded clause
entries.context: Who you think is the best candidate for the team leader role?

entries.vietlish: she dressed very elegant for the event
entries.natural: she dressed very elegantly for the event
entries.sourcePattern: ăn mặc rất thanh lịch -> adjective used as adverb after dressed
entries.context: She dressed very elegant for the event and impressed everyone there.

entries.vietlish: which restaurant you recommend in this area
entries.natural: which restaurant do you recommend in this area
entries.sourcePattern: bạn giới thiệu nhà hàng nào -> no do-support in which-question
entries.context: Which restaurant you recommend in this area for a birthday dinner?

entries.vietlish: he is very economy with money
entries.natural: he is very economical with money
entries.sourcePattern: tiết kiệm -> economy used as adjective, direct transfer
entries.context: He is very economy with money so he saves a large part of his salary.

entries.vietlish: she is always a positive person
entries.natural: she is always an optimistic person
entries.sourcePattern: tích cực -> positive for optimistic, direct calque
entries.context: She is always a positive person even when things are difficult around her.

entries.vietlish: I feel passion about teaching children
entries.natural: I am passionate about teaching children
entries.sourcePattern: say mê -> passion used as stative verb instead of passionate
entries.context: I feel passion about teaching children and helping them grow every day.

entries.vietlish: he is very talent in drawing
entries.natural: he is very talented in drawing
entries.sourcePattern: tài năng -> talent used as adjective without -ed suffix
entries.context: He is very talent in drawing and wins art competitions at school.

entries.vietlish: I need to control my expenses better
entries.natural: I need to manage my expenses better
entries.sourcePattern: quản lý -> control for manage, overlap in VN learner vocabulary
entries.context: I need to control my expenses better this month, I overspent again.

entries.vietlish: the job market is very competitive but I am passion
entries.natural: the job market is very competitive but I am passionate
entries.sourcePattern: say mê -> passion used as predicate adjective
entries.context: The job market is very competitive but I am passion about my field.

entries.vietlish: I note ten out of ten on the final exam
entries.natural: I got ten out of ten on the final exam
entries.sourcePattern: điểm 10 -> điểm means both note and grade in Vietnamese
entries.context: I note ten out of ten on the final exam, the teacher was surprised.

entries.vietlish: did you pass the high school last year
entries.natural: did you graduate from high school last year
entries.sourcePattern: tốt nghiệp -> pass used for graduate from school
entries.context: Did you pass the high school last year? Which university are you at now?

entries.vietlish: I want to confirm this news to you before anyone else
entries.natural: I want to share this news with you before anyone else
entries.sourcePattern: xác nhận/thông báo -> confirm used for inform or share
entries.context: I want to confirm this news to you before anyone else hears it.

entries.vietlish: my colleague has a lot of humor in meetings
entries.natural: my colleague has a great sense of humor in meetings
entries.sourcePattern: hài hước -> has humor without sense of, direct VN calque
entries.context: My colleague has a lot of humor in meetings and keeps everyone laughing.

entries.vietlish: my manager is very professional and high manner
entries.natural: my manager is very professional and well-mannered
entries.sourcePattern: phong cách cao -> high manner calque for well-mannered
entries.context: My manager is very professional and high manner in all his communications.

entries.vietlish: I sympathy with you about that difficult situation
entries.natural: I sympathize with you about that difficult situation
entries.sourcePattern: cảm thông -> sympathy used directly as a verb
entries.context: I sympathy with you about that difficult situation at work.

entries.vietlish: she is very passionate and enthusiasm about the job
entries.natural: she is very passionate and enthusiastic about the job
entries.sourcePattern: nhiệt tình -> enthusiasm used as predicate adjective
entries.context: She is very passionate and enthusiasm about the job since day one.

entries.vietlish: she is beautiful in the outside but cold in the inside
entries.natural: she is beautiful on the outside but cold on the inside
entries.sourcePattern: ở bên ngoài/bên trong -> in for on with inside and outside
entries.context: She is beautiful in the outside but cold in the inside, be careful.

entries.vietlish: I learn English by self at home
entries.natural: I learn English by myself at home
entries.sourcePattern: tự học -> by self calque for by myself
entries.context: I learn English by self at home using videos and podcasts daily.

entries.vietlish: she is very normal and easy to approach
entries.natural: she is very down-to-earth and easy to approach
entries.sourcePattern: bình dân -> normal for down-to-earth/approachable
entries.context: She is very normal and easy to approach, not arrogant or difficult at all.

entries.vietlish: she is very live and full of energy all day
entries.natural: she is very lively and full of energy all day
entries.sourcePattern: sống động -> live used as predicate adjective without -ly suffix
entries.context: She is very live and full of energy all day, everyone admires her.

entries.vietlish: the presentation is very profession and well-prepared
entries.natural: the presentation is very professional and well-prepared
entries.sourcePattern: chuyên nghiệp -> profession used as predicate adjective
entries.context: The presentation is very profession and well-prepared, well done to the team.

entries.vietlish: I feel full stomach after the big meal
entries.natural: I feel full after the big meal
entries.sourcePattern: no bụng -> full stomach calque for simply full
entries.context: Thank you so much for the food, I feel full stomach after the big meal.

entries.vietlish: my phone is out of memory, I cannot install the app
entries.natural: my phone is out of storage, I cannot install the app
entries.sourcePattern: bộ nhớ -> memory for storage in VN tech context
entries.context: My phone is out of memory, I cannot install the app you sent me.

entries.vietlish: she is a diligent and study-hard person
entries.natural: she is a diligent and hardworking person
entries.sourcePattern: chăm chỉ học hành -> study-hard as compound adjective calque
entries.context: She is a diligent and study-hard person, always the top of the class.

entries.vietlish: he is very confident and self-believe in his abilities
entries.natural: he is very confident and self-assured in his abilities
entries.sourcePattern: tự tin -> self-believe compound for self-confident/self-assured
entries.context: He is very confident and self-believe in his abilities, nothing shakes him.

entries.vietlish: my workplace is very comfortable and modernize
entries.natural: my workplace is very comfortable and modern
entries.sourcePattern: hiện đại hóa/hiện đại -> modernize used as predicate adjective
entries.context: My workplace is very comfortable and modernize, I enjoy coming to work.

entries.vietlish: I have a negative mood today, leave me alone
entries.natural: I'm in a bad mood today, leave me alone
entries.sourcePattern: tâm trạng tiêu cực -> negative mood calque for bad mood
entries.context: I have a negative mood today, leave me alone please.

entries.vietlish: she broke her tears when she heard the bad news
entries.natural: she burst into tears when she heard the bad news
entries.sourcePattern: vỡ òa nước mắt -> broke her tears calque for burst into tears
entries.context: She broke her tears when she heard the bad news about her friend.

entries.vietlish: she is at her best ages, so full of life
entries.natural: she is in her prime, so full of life
entries.sourcePattern: tuổi đẹp nhất -> best ages calque for in her prime
